title: Firewall default inbound action is to allow

report.title: {Items.Count} firewall {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy allows', 'policies allow')} inbound traffic by default

messages.businessImpact: Anything not explicitly blocked can reach the device, which inverts how a firewall is meant to work.
remediation: Set the default inbound action to Block and add rules for the traffic that is genuinely needed.
